name: fr-services
//deps: next carries a caret so `npm update` picks up the 15.x security patches on its own — a pinned 15.5.4 sitting on a critical advisory is how this got noticed in the first place. react is pinned exactly: a React minor can change what renders, and identical rendering is the one thing this build must not lose.
//overrides: Next pins postcss 8.4.31 and sharp ^0.34.5, and 16.x still does, so no Next upgrade clears their advisories. Both are build-time only here and nothing imports from next/ at all — no next/image, so sharp is never called. Bumped anyway, because an unfixable advisory in the report trains you to ignore the report. Minor bumps inside the same major; build output was diffed before and after.
